title: Kth Largest Using QuickSelect
statement:
Given an array of N distinct integers and a positive integer K, find the K-th largest element.

Use the **QuickSelect** algorithm (a selection algorithm based on QuickSort's partition step) for expected O(N) time:
1. Choose a pivot randomly.
2. Partition: elements > pivot go left, < pivot go right.
3. Recurse into the side that contains the K-th position.

Note: QuickSelect has O(N^2) worst case. For the test cases given, expected O(N) is sufficient.
inputFormat:
Line 1: two integers N and K.
Line 2: N space-separated integers.
outputFormat: A single integer: the K-th largest element.
constraints:
1 <= K <= N <= 10^5
-10^9 <= A[i] <= 10^9
All elements are distinct.
